description: Platform keys the verifier trusts (ADR-009, ADR-015, ADR-016). Relayer entries are checked against block.timestamp of the anchor; receipt entries against the receipt's self-declared acceptedAt, which is a consistency check only. Rotation = add an entry; revocation = set revokedAt. Revocation is off-chain only: PostAnchor has no admin. These are the PoC keys generated by the KMS simulator on 2026-11-08 (testnets only).

keys.note: PoC receipt-signing key, chain-agnostic because the "Onchain Receipts" domain has no chainId
